items.claim: A CORS misconfiguration (e.g., reflecting an arbitrary Origin or trusting a permissive cross-domain whitelist) disables the same-origin policy, letting a malicious site read authenticated responses from the victim's browser.
items.body: CORS relaxes the same-origin policy via Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Dangerous configurations include: reflecting the request's Origin header back without validation, using a wildcard with credentials, trusting all subdomains, or echoing the literal null origin. When combined with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, any attacker site can issue credentialed requests and read the response, enabling session/token theft and account compromise. Even without credentials, trusting a vulnerable subdomain or third-party origin chains trust into attacks such as XSS. Prevention: explicit allowlist of exact origins (scheme+host+port), no reflection, no wildcard with credentials, and never trust null.
items.disproof: If Access-Control-Allow-Origin is absent or set to a fixed, allowlisted origin; if Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is absent or set to false; or if the server rejects the attacker-controlled Origin with a non-200 refusal, the misconfiguration is neutralized and cross-origin reads are blocked.

sources.quote: An HTML5 cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy controls whether and how content running on other domains can perform two-way interaction with the domain that publishes the policy.

The product uses a web-client protection mechanism such as a Content Security Policy (CSP) or cross-domain policy file, but the policy includes untrusted domains with which the web client is allowed to communicate.

A CORS misconfiguration turns a same-origin protection into cross-origin data exposure: if a server reflects an arbitrary Origin back in ACAO and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, any website the victim's browser visits can silently issue authenticated, cookie-bearing requests to the vulnerable app and read the response.
